description: Card: their generated images, numbered, newest first; Show more keeps counting. WHEN: they choose one of their images. Say one line and stop; never draw them. A pick arrives as their message (id, url). A typed number n: the card has its url; else confirm row n of `list_images` (`status: succeeded`) with them. No card (terminal): `list_images`. Free.
name: show_images
title: Show the user's images as a picker
